summary: This snippet disables directory listing in Apache. When someone tries to visit a folder URL without specifying a file, instead of seeing a list of files in that directory, they'll get a forbidden error. It's a common security practice to hide what files are on your server.

explanations.1: IfModule checks if a particular Apache module (mod_autoindex) is loaded before running the code inside. This prevents errors if the module isn't available.
explanations.2: The minus sign before 'Indexes' means we're turning OFF that feature. Without this line, Apache would show a directory listing by default.
